children: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - September 17, 2026) - Patrick McAllister, Manager, Equity Advisory and Portfolio Management, RBC Dominion Securities (RBC DS), and his team joined Omar Khafagy, Head, Client Success, Toronto Stock Exchange ("TSX") and TSX Venture Exchange ("TSXV"), to open the market and recognize the RBC DS investment advisor network.

RBC DS investment advisors will be participating in TSX Connects, a key initiative within the TSX Company Services Corporate Access Program, providing a platform for direct engagement between listed issuers and retail capital.

RBC Dominion Securities directly serves over 600,000 affluent, high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients across Canada with full-service investment management, wealth planning and banking solutions. RBC Dominion Securities is the largest wealth management firm in the country, backed by Canada's leading financial institution with more than 2,000 advisors.
For more information, please visit RBC Dominion Securities.

title: RBC Dominion Securities Opens the Market
